about: Questions of the kinds agents answer by hand with gh, against the public repositories temet-ai/mike and temet-ai/ask-kit. Each names its repository, because the kit otherwise answers about the repository the agent works in. Expectations are what GitHub says as of 2026-11-18.

questions.q: In temet-ai/mike, has the capture thread-link work in issues 350 to 354 been fixed? Which of those issues are closed and which are still open?
Was pull request 387 in temet-ai/mike merged, and with which merge commit?
In temet-ai/mike, did the fix for fleet_report's evidence argument (issue 336) land? Is the issue closed?
In temet-ai/mike, what was the slow_queries problem with a statement whose SQL was edited, and how was it fixed (issue and PR)?
Two ci runs on main in temet-ai/ask-kit failed on 2026-11-18 around 06:06-06:08 UTC. Why did each fail, and which commits fixed them?
